title: Sphere of Mystic Realms
description: A silhouetted figure stands on a floating platform inside a large transparent sphere, reaching toward glowing purple lightning and swirling magenta ribbons. Within the sphere is a surreal night landscape featuring a green glowing portal with a crescent moon, a small castle, pink trees, and reflective water.
prompt: A silhouetted human figure standing on a grassy platform inside a giant transparent bubble, reaching out to touch bright purple lightning bolts and flowing magenta ribbons that swirl around them. Inside the bubble is a dreamy fantasy landscape with a glowing green circular portal containing a crescent moon, a small castle, pink cherry blossom trees, and reflective water below, all set against a dark cosmic background.
